mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 200k signals improved labor market strength, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS 3-month delta > 200000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the Housing Starts Index below 1.2 million units signals weakening residential demand, which reduces construction-related earnings and drags on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when HOUST 3-month average < 1200000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary stance, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS 3-month average > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures per Capita below $700 signals weakening household demand, which reduces corporate sales and earnings, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS 3-month average < 700 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the Industrial Production Index below 101 signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings for industrial firms and drags on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO 3-month average < 101 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE 3-month average > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the CPI-U below 2.5% signals easing inflationary pressure, which reduces the probability of aggressive Fed tightening and supports higher equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when CPIAUCSL 3-month average < 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05).
